title: Flipping an Image
description:
You are given a square binary matrix image of size n × n.

Do the following for each row:

Reverse the row (flip horizontally)
Invert all values:
0 → 1
1 → 0

Return the final matrix.
input_format:
The first line contains two integers m and n.
The next m lines each contain n space-separated integers.
output_format: Print the result line by line using space-separated integers.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 20
image[i][j] is either 0 or 1
Matrix is always square
